block.txt: An Act to appropriate out of the Consolidated Fund sums for the services of the Government for the year 2023–24.
This Act is the Appropriation Act 2023.
This Act commences on the date of assent to this Act.
In this Act—
services includes the following—
capital works and services,
recurrent services,
repayment of debt.
year 2023–24 means the year from 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024.

heading.b: Appropriation to Treasurer relating to integrity agencies

block.txt: This Act appropriates the sum of $20,000,000 to the Treasurer out of the Consolidated Fund for contingencies in relation to the integrity agencies for the year 2023–24.

integrity agency means each of the following—

heading.b: Payments not to be in excess of sums specified

block.txt: Payment of a sum must not be made from the Consolidated Fund for a purpose for the year 2023–24 if the sum is more than the sum appropriated for the purpose by this Act or the Appropriation (Parliament) Act 2023.
Subsection (1) does not limit a payment authorised by—
this part, or
the Government Sector Finance Act 2018, Part 4.

The Treasurer may authorise the payment of a sum appropriated by this Act for a purpose specified in Part 4 for an integrity agency other than the Audit Office of New South Wales that is more than the sum specified for the purpose if—
the Treasurer is of the opinion that—
the sum appropriated for the purpose is insufficient to enable the purpose to be effectively and efficiently carried out, and
the additional sum is reasonably necessary for the integrity agency to effectively and efficiently carry out the purpose, and
an equivalent sum is not paid out from the sum appropriated to the Treasurer by section 21.

The Treasurer may authorise the payment of a sum from the sum appropriated to the Treasurer by section 21 to the Audit Office of New South Wales for the services of the Office if the Treasurer is of the opinion that the sum is reasonably necessary for the Office to effectively and efficiently carry out the functions the Office and provide the services of the Office.
In this section—
integrity agency has the same meaning as in section 21.
The Treasurer may authorise the payment of a sum appropriated for a purpose by this Act or the Appropriation (Parliament) Act 2023 that is more than the sum specified for the purpose if—

the Treasurer is of the opinion that the additional sum is reasonably necessary because of expenditure related to the Government’s response to address a natural disaster or the impacts of a natural disaster in the Northern Rivers or Central West regions, and
an equivalent sum is not paid out from the sum appropriated to the Treasurer by section 22.

heading.b: Variations—exigencies of Government and appropriations insufficient for purpose

block.txt: The Treasurer may authorise the payment of a sum appropriated by this Act or the Appropriation (Parliament) Act 2023 for a purpose that is more than the sum specified for the purpose if—
the Treasurer is of the opinion that the exigencies of Government require the payment, and
an equivalent sum is not paid out for another purpose, whether the other purpose is specified in relation to the same or a different Minister.
The Treasurer may authorise the payment of a sum appropriated by this Act for a purpose that is more than the sum specified for the purpose if—
the Treasurer is of the opinion that the sum appropriated for the purpose is insufficient to enable the purpose to be effectively and efficiently carried out, and

an equivalent sum is identified as surplus to another purpose by the Minister in relation to whom the other purpose is specified, whether the other purpose is specified in relation to the same or a different Minister, and
the equivalent sum is not paid out for the other purpose.
The Treasurer must not, under this section, authorise the payment of a sum appropriated under a part of this Act to be paid out for a purpose other than a purpose specified in the part.

heading.b: Treasurer must not increase fixed salary or wages

block.txt: The Treasurer must not authorise the payment of a sum under this part that increases salary or wages if the amount of the salary or wages is fixed by law.

heading.b: Part does not apply to sums appropriated by another Act

block.txt: This part does not apply to sums appropriated by another Act except as otherwise provided in this part.

heading.b: Treasurer must inform Auditor-General of authorisations

block.txt: The Treasurer must inform the Auditor-General of every authorisation given under this part.
An authorisation under this part may be given before or after the payment is made.

heading.b: Appointment of person to carry out functions of Treasurer under Part 6

block.txt: The Treasurer may appoint a person to carry out the Treasurer’s functions under Part 6.
The appointment is subject to the conditions, if any, that the Treasurer decides.
The Treasurer may revoke the appointment at any time.

A person appointed under this section has, in place of the Treasurer, the Treasurer’s function under section 40 of informing the Auditor-General of every authorisation given by the person under Part 6.

heading.b: Appointment of accountable authority to identify surplus

block.txt: A Minister may appoint the accountable authority for a GSF agency for which the Minister is the responsible Minister to carry out the Minister’s functions under section 37(2)(b).
The appointment is subject to the conditions, if any, that the Minister determines.
The Minister may revoke the appointment at any time.
In this section—
accountable authority, for a GSF agency, has the same meaning as in the Government Sector Finance Act 2018.
GSF agency has the same meaning as in the Government Sector Finance Act 2018.
Budget-related information—
does not form part of this Act, and
does not affect the application of an amount appropriated by this Act.
In this section—
budget-related information means—
notes included in this Act relating to expenses and capital expenditure, and
Budget Papers of the Government tabled in Parliament in connection with the Bill for this Act.
this Act includes the Appropriation (Parliament) Act 2023.

heading.b: Payments authorised on lapse of appropriation

block.txt: An amount is taken to have been expended out of a sum appropriated for a purpose by this Act if the amount—
was paid for the purpose out of the Consolidated Fund under the Government Sector Finance Act 2018, section 4.10, and
was paid on or after 1 July 2023 and before the date of assent to this Act.
See also the Appropriation (Parliament) Act 2023 and the Treasury and Revenue Legislation Amendment Act 2023.
